messages:
elaine: Quick heads-up: starting a targeted least-privilege sweep focusing on admin entitlements and KMS bindings. Goal: remove stale admin roles, but preserve crypto paths for scheduled jobs. Running a small canary first.

noah: What's our stale threshold? I'm thinking 90d for human accounts, 180d for service accounts unless tagged `monthly-job=true`.

jordan: Agree on split thresholds. Also we should capture both API calls and console logins as `last_seen`. I'll include last_key_use for KMS principals.

dev-bot: preflight: scanned 1,672 principals. Flags: 71 admin-level bindings, 27 KMS keys with non-owner principals. Report: https://ops.internal/scan/2445001234 (restricted).

elaine: Canary plan: pick two infra services + one analytics job that touches KMS. For canary we will demote admin->viewer for flagged non-owner principals for 36h and monitor runs.

noah: Need safety for KMS: before changing key policies, run this probe per principal: 
```bash
# try an envelope decryption with the principal's service account
gcloud kms decrypt --key=projects/p/locations/global/keyRings/r/cryptoKey --ciphertext-file=/tmp/ct --project=PROJECT --impersonate-service-account=${PRINCIPAL}
```
If it fails, add `needs-owner-review` instead of auto-removal.

jordan: We'll snapshot current IAM and KMS policies to gs://compliance-snapshots/2445001234/ before any mutation. Auditor wants immutable copies and a simple justification log.

auditor: Please include a CSV: principal, role, resource, last_seen, kms_probe_result, suggested_action, owner_contact. Keep snapshots retention 7y for audit.

elaine: Owner ping draft: "Hi @owner, security is running an entitlement clean-up. `<principal>` has `<role>` on `<resource>` and shows no activity since `<last_seen>`. Reply within 7 days to request exemption or tag resource `priv-skip=true`. Non-responses will be demoted. -security"

noah: Rollback playbook: `infra/tools/rbac-restore --snapshot gs://compliance-snapshots/2445001234/batch-<n>.json` and add note: revert-tag `priv-revert=<batch>` to resource metadata.

jordan: Alerting: if canary causes >2 failed scheduled jobs or any KMS decryption errors in production, pause all automation and notify #eng-oncall and #product-security.

elaine: Action items:
- noah: run KMS probes and produce `kms_probe_result` column (ETA: Thu)
- jordan: take immutable snapshots + create restore artifacts (ETA: Thu)
- dev-bot: implement `priv-skip=true`/`monthly-job=true` tag detection and generate owner pings (ETA: Wed)
- auditor: confirm CSV schema for compliance (ETA: Fri)

noah: small note: include `reapply_command` in CSV for each principal to speed restores.

elaine: OK launching canary on Monday 08:00 PT. Keeping thread pinned for live runbook updates. Please react with :lock: when you've reviewed.

dev-bot: reminder: automation will respect `priv-skip=true` and abort if snapshot upload fails.

jordan: LGTM. If we see weirdness, we escalate to incident response.

auditor: Confirmed CSV schema. I'll pull snapshots after canary completes.
